statement: L/40 冲击算例的质量守恒 max|dM|/M = 7.95e-04（自 t=0 口径，判据 < 1e-3 PASS），100 步包络松弛后口径为 1.13e-03（超阈，两口径同时记录）；同一标度下静水基线（3960 单元）的壁压剖面对 rho g (h_l - y) 的L2 相对误差 0.1056（判据 < 0.01 FAIL，最大相对误差 0.3298）。故自由面 LBM 的质量封闭在该算例可接受，而压力剖面保真度不满足 1% 判据；质量守恒是源报告七条判据中唯一 PASS 的一条。

scope.system: Korner free-surface LBM, D3Q19, single grid L/40
conditions: surge-release impact case and still-water hydrostatic case, same scaling
exclusions: hydrostatic L2 value is source-reported, not re-derived here (see notes)

notes: the hydrostatic L2 error is not re-derivable from the published artefact: the artefact stores the breadth-averaged density profile, while the reported error is formed over interior liquid cells; the number is therefore recorded as reported-only
